title: Kubeshark: MCP `start_kubeshark` argument injection via `pod_regex` → image redirect → cluster takeover…
description: A command injection vulnerability exists in the kubeshark MCP tool's start_kubeshark command due to improper handling of the pod_regex argument. This flaw allows an attacker with local access and certain privileges to inject arbitrary Helm --set flags, redirecting container images to attacker-controlled registries. The deployed containers run privileged with host network and filesystem access, enabling full Kubernetes cluster takeover. The vulnerability affects versions from v53.1.0 up to but not including v53.4.0 and is fixed in v53.4.0.
